title: Jazzy Flaky Greek Ham Bowl
description: A resinous, flaky, one-pot Greek dish featuring ham, nuka-pickle, and a focus on fodmap-friendly ingredients. Serve in an earthenware bowl for a rustic touch.

ingredients.name: Nuka-pickle
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought, drained and chopped.

instructions: In a large earthenware bowl, combine diced ham, nuka-pickle, Greek yogurt, parsley, dill, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well to combine.
Roll out phyllo dough to a size slightly larger than the bowl. Place the dough in the bowl, over the ham mixture, and tuck the edges under the dough.
Dot the top of the phyllo dough with unsalted butter and fold the edges of the dough under the top to create a decorative border.
Bake in preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the phyllo dough is golden brown and puffed.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving, flaky and puffed from the bowl.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
